facts.fact: RSF says the HAC suspended the private radio phone-in programme Allo Klédu for two months from 19 June 2026 over listeners' contributions, and that journalists Takiou and Keïta were arrested in June 2026 and charged under the cybercrime law.
RSF says the Maison de la Presse sharply criticised the detention of the two journalists in June 2026, saying the judiciary had fallen short of creating a space of peace and understanding.
